headline: VP calls on NEEC to oversee the consolidation of 75 economic funds into a single fund
summary: Vice President Deogratius Ndejembi called on the National Economic Empowerment Council to oversee merging 75 economic empowerment funds and programmes into a single fund. The aim is to simplify access to capital and loan guarantees, especially for young people.
why: Public economic empowerment funds channel government credit and loan guarantees to businesses and households, so consolidation changes how state-backed lending reaches borrowers.
